purpose.summary: This is a Data Access Layer (DAL) module for the Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS) that handles Purchase Invoice relational database operations using MySQL via a JC preSQL preprocessor. It manages two database tables (PUINVOICE-REC for invoice headers and PUINV-LINES-REC for up to 40 line items per invoice), providing CRUD operations (read, write, rewrite, delete, seek/start) and translating between COBOL flat-file semantics and relational database rows. It is called by the COBOL flat-file handler module acas026.

verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars of a 134688-byte file (3338 lines total). The dialect is clearly GnuCOBOL free-format with MySQL embedded SQL via a custom 'JC preSQL' preprocessor. The program is part of a larger accounting system (ACAS v3.02+) with a well-documented version history spanning 2016-2018. The copy_count=0 in mechanical indicators but 'copy "envdiv.cob"' appears in the visible source, suggesting the counter may not have detected quoted COPY statements.
